notes:
### Research Notes: Lark (Larksuite)

#### **What the product does**
Lark is an all-in-one collaboration and productivity suite that integrates messaging, video conferencing, cloud storage, project management (Lark Base), and document collaboration into a single platform.
*   **Source:** [larksuite.com](https://www.larksuite.com/en_us/plans) - "Lark presents itself as an all-in-one collaboration platform that will streamline communication, boost productivity, and bring together a number of workplace tools into a single solution."

#### **Authentication Methods**
Lark provides several access token types depending on the application's needs:
*   **`tenant_access_token`**: Used for internal "Custom Apps" to access tenant-level data.
*   **`app_access_token`**: Used for app-level operations (e.g., bot identity).
*   **`user_access_token` (OAuth 2.0)**: Represents a specific user's identity and permissions.
*   **Multi-tenant Integration Choice**: A multi-tenant platform like Composio would use **`oauth2`** to obtain a `user_access_token`.
*   **Source:** [Lark Open Platform Docs](https://open.larksuite.com/document/server-docs/authentication-management/access-token/obtain-access-tokens) - "User access token: Represents the identity of a user... suitable for scenarios where the app needs to act on behalf of a user."

#### **Credential Acquisition & Cost**
*   **Access Level**: `self_serve_free` (for development/internal apps) / `approval_required` (for multi-tenant Store Apps).
*   **Developer Sign-up**: Any user can log into the [Lark Developer Console](https://open.larksuite.com/app) for free to create "Custom Apps."
*   **Multi-tenant (Store App)**: To build a multi-tenant integration for the Lark App Directory, developers must apply for **ISV (Independent Software Vendor) qualification**.
*   **Cost**: Lark offers a free "Starter" plan that includes API access.
    *   **Source:** [Lark Developer Policy](https://open.larksuite.com/document/ukTMukTMukTM/uMTNz4yM1MjLzUzM) - "We do not currently charge for use of our APIs; however, we reserve the right to do so in the future."
    *   **Source:** [Chanty (Review)](https://www.chanty.com/blog/lark-pricing/) - "Starter users get 10,000 API calls per month... Core features including Authentication and Authorization... are free to use, regardless of your Lark plan."
*   **Approval**: Store apps require a formal review process by the Lark Open Platform team before they can be installed by other tenants.

#### **API Style & Details**
*   **Style**: **REST**
*   **Breadth**: Extremely broad, covering Messenger (IM), Calendar, Docs, Bitable (Base), Tasks, Contacts, and Wiki.
*   **OpenAPI Spec**: Lark provides an official API Explorer and uses OpenAPI definitions for its official MCP server.
*   **Webhooks**: Supported via "Event Subscriptions" (e.g., message received, department changed).
*   **Sandbox**: Developers can create a "Test Enterprise" within the Developer Console to debug apps without affecting production data.
*   **Source:** [Lark API List](https://open.larksuite.com/document/server-docs/api-access-management/api-list) - "Lark provides a wealth of server-side APIs... based on the HTTP protocol."

#### **MCP Servers**
*   **Official**: Yes, Lark maintains an official MCP server.
    *   **Source:** [GitHub - larksuite/lark-openapi-mcp](https://github.com/larksuite/lark-openapi-mcp) - "This is the Feishu/Lark official OpenAPI MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool designed to help users quickly connect to the Feishu/Lark platform."
*   **Community**: Several community versions exist (e.g., `lorrylockie/lark-mcp`).

#### **Buildability Verdict**
**Verdict**: `ready_with_friction`
*   **Main Blocker**: While a developer can start building immediately with a "Custom App," a multi-tenant integration requires **ISV qualification and a formal App Store review process** to be distributed to other Lark customers.
*   **Source:** [Lark Docs](https://open.larksuite.com/document/home/introduction-to-scope-and-authorization/overview) - "Only users with ISV qualifications can create store apps... The permissions will take effect only after the app review is approved."
